stable](https://lifecycle.r-lib.org/articles/figures/lifecycle-stable.svg)

**CerebroNexus** (**Ce**ll**Re**port**Bro**wser **Nexus**) is a
[Shiny](https://shiny.posit.co/) platform for exploring and sharing
single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data, with gene-expression,
immune-repertoire, trajectory, and HLA-TCR analyses. See the [full
documentation](https://mihem.github.io/CerebroNexus/).

**Builder** prepares your data and packages an App. **Viewer** opens the
result for interactive exploration and sharing.

[Install](#install) · [Builder](#run-builder) · [Viewer
demos](#run-the-viewer-demos) · [Large
datasets](#run-both-large-datasets) · [Project layout](#project-layout)
· [Guides](#guides)

[Try the live demo](https://osmzhlab.uni-muenster.de/shiny/demo/).

*CerebroNexus began as a fork of
[cerebroApp](https://github.com/romanhaa/cerebroApp) by Roman Hillje and
has since evolved with substantial new features and active development
by [mihem](https://github.com/mihem) and [Xuesong
Wang](https://github.com/duocang).*

Automated tests run in a reproducible Nix environment.

![CerebroNexus spatial data view](reference/figures/featured.png)

CerebroNexus spatial data view

## Install

``` r
install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("mihem/CerebroNexus")
install.packages(c("Seurat", "shinymanager")) # Builder and login-enabled Apps
```

Seurat is needed for Builder; `shinymanager >= 1.1.0` is needed only for
login-enabled Apps. Optional input/backend packages are listed in the
[Builder
guide](https://mihem.github.io/CerebroNexus/articles/build_a_data_set_by_pointing.html).
Exported Apps still require R and the Viewer dependencies on the
destination machine.

## Run Builder

``` r
CerebroNexus::launchCerebroBuilder()
```

Builder opens in your browser and runs locally. Import trusted Seurat
`.rds`, `.qs2` or `.qs` files, or choose **Load example datasets** to
try it without your own data.

![CerebroNexus Builder configuring a bundled example
dataset](reference/figures/builder.png)

CerebroNexus Builder configuring a bundled example dataset

1.  **Data** — add one or more datasets, or reopen a saved Builder
    project.
2.  **Configure** — choose expression, groups, projections and optional
    analyses; inspect spatial views and align background images.
3.  **Review** — check the included content and resolve blocking issues.
4.  **Build** — export reusable CRB bundles or a standalone Viewer App,
    optionally protected by login.

**Save** keeps an editable Builder project for later work. **Build**
creates a separate release inside the output folder you choose. A Viewer
App release has this layout (simplified):

``` text
release/
├── cerebro_app/
│   ├── app.R
│   ├── private-data/       # Datasets and required sidecars
│   ├── viewer/             # Bundled Viewer runtime
│   └── viewer-auth.env     # Login-enabled releases only; keep private
└── build-report.json
```

Run the exported App with
`shiny::runApp("path/to/release/cerebro_app")`. Keep the entire App
directory together when moving or sharing it; CRB-only releases instead
contain the `.crb` files and their required sidecars.

On Linux, run `bash viewer/start-linux.sh` from the exported App
directory to prepare login-file permissions and start Viewer, including
after copying from Windows. For a service deployment, run
`sudo bash viewer/start-linux.sh --prepare-only --user shiny` once with
the actual service account, then start the service normally. See the
bundled `viewer/AUTHENTICATION-DEPLOYMENT.md` for details.

## Convert from a script

``` r
# Seurat, SingleCellExperiment, AnnData (.h5ad / .zarr), MuData (.h5mu)
# or SpatialData
convertSeuratToCerebro(
  seurat_file = "my_seurat.rds",
  result_dir = "output",
  groups = c("sample", "cluster")
)
convertSCEToCerebro(sce, "output", groups = "cluster")
convertH5adToCerebro("my_data.h5ad", "output", groups = "cell_type")
convertSpatialDataToCerebro("my_data.zarr", "output", groups = "cell_type")

createShinyApp(
  cerebro_data = c("My dataset" = "output/cerebro_my_seurat.crb"),
  result_dir = "my_app"
)
```

No Python is needed to read AnnData or SpatialData; see the vignette
[Use SingleCellExperiment and AnnData
data](https://mihem.github.io/CerebroNexus/vignettes/use_sce_and_anndata_data.Rmd).

## Run the Viewer demos

In R, launch the bundled demo app (PBMC, Spatial, Trekker and HLA/TCR):

``` r
shiny::runApp(system.file("app.R", package = "CerebroNexus"), launch.browser = TRUE)
```

Switch datasets using **Sample data set**. For the basic Viewer example,
use
[`CerebroNexus::launchCerebro()`](https://mihem.github.io/CerebroNexus/reference/launchCerebro.md).
Use separate R sessions to run Builder and Viewer at the same time.

## Run both large datasets

For **Mouse 1M + Ren 1.46M**, alongside the bundled demos, run in a
terminal with R and the package dependencies available:

``` bash
git clone https://github.com/mihem/CerebroNexus.git
cd CerebroNexus
Rscript -e "install.packages(c('remotes', 'pkgload')); remotes::install_local('.', dependencies = TRUE)"
Rscript run-demo.R
```

The launcher uses the current checkout and prints the local URL, usually
`http://127.0.0.1:7451`. First-time preparation downloads about **18
GB**; allow **100 GB free disk space**. Later runs reuse complete
compatible caches. Keep each `.crb` with its `.bpcells/` directory.

Optional flags: `--prepare-only` prepares without launching,
`--ren-only` skips Mouse, and `--no-browser` lets you open the printed
URL yourself (useful in WSL).

## Project layout

| Path | Purpose |
|----|----|
| `R/` | Package API, data conversion and App export |
| `inst/builder/` | Builder interface and build workflow |
| `inst/viewer/` | Viewer interface and runtime |
| `inst/app.R`, `inst/extdata/examples/` | Bundled demo App and datasets |
| `run-demo.R` | Launcher for both large datasets and the bundled demos |
| `data-raw/` | Scripts for rebuilding demo data |
| `vignettes/`, `tests/` | User guides and tests |

# Package index

## Launch Cerebro

- [`launchCerebro()`](https://mihem.github.io/CerebroNexus/reference/launchCerebro.md)
  : Launch CerebroNexus
- [`launchCerebroBuilder()`](https://mihem.github.io/CerebroNexus/reference/launchCerebroBuilder.md)
  : Build a Cerebro data set from a Seurat object, by pointing and
  clicking.

## Export data

- [`exportFromSCE()`](https://mihem.github.io/CerebroNexus/reference/exportFromSCE.md)
  : Export SingleCellExperiment (SCE) object to Cerebro.
- [`exportFromSeurat()`](https://mihem.github.io/CerebroNexus/reference/exportFromSeurat.md)
  : Export Seurat object to Cerebro.
- [`exportToH5ad()`](https://mihem.github.io/CerebroNexus/reference/exportToH5ad.md)
  : Export a Cerebro file to AnnData (h5ad)

## Convert data

- [`convertCerebro()`](https://mihem.github.io/CerebroNexus/reference/convertCerebro.md)
  : Convert a Cerebro data file
- [`convertH5adToCerebro()`](https://mihem.github.io/CerebroNexus/reference/convertH5adToCerebro.md)
  : Convert an AnnData (h5ad) file to a Cerebro file
- [`convertSCEToCerebro()`](https://mihem.github.io/CerebroNexus/reference/convertSCEToCerebro.md)
  : Convert a SingleCellExperiment object to a Cerebro file
- [`convertSCEToSeurat()`](https://mihem.github.io/CerebroNexus/reference/convertSCEToSeurat.md)
  : Convert a SingleCellExperiment into a Seurat object
- [`convertSeuratToCerebro()`](https://mihem.github.io/CerebroNexus/reference/convertSeuratToCerebro.md)
  : Convert Seurat Object to Cerebro Format
- [`convertSpatialDataToCerebro()`](https://mihem.github.io/CerebroNexus/reference/convertSpatialDataToCerebro.md)
  : Convert a SpatialData store to a Cerebro object
- [`readH5adAsSCE()`](https://mihem.github.io/CerebroNexus/reference/readH5adAsSCE.md)
  : Read an h5ad file as a SingleCellExperiment
- [`readSpatialDataAsSCE()`](https://mihem.github.io/CerebroNexus/reference/readSpatialDataAsSCE.md)
  : Read a SpatialData store as a SingleCellExperiment

## Pre-processing

- [`addPercentMtRibo()`](https://mihem.github.io/CerebroNexus/reference/addPercentMtRibo.md)
  : Add percentage of mitochondrial and ribosomal transcripts.
- [`calculatePercentGenes()`](https://mihem.github.io/CerebroNexus/reference/calculatePercentGenes.md)
  : Calculate percentage of transcripts of gene list.
- [`getMostExpressedGenes()`](https://mihem.github.io/CerebroNexus/reference/getMostExpressedGenes.md)
  : Get most expressed genes for specified grouping variables in Seurat
  object.
- [`getMarkerGenes()`](https://mihem.github.io/CerebroNexus/reference/getMarkerGenes.md)
  : Get marker genes for specified grouping variables in Seurat object.
- [`getEnrichedPathways()`](https://mihem.github.io/CerebroNexus/reference/getEnrichedPathways.md)
  : Get enriched pathways based on marker genes from EnrichR.
- [`performGeneSetEnrichmentAnalysis()`](https://mihem.github.io/CerebroNexus/reference/performGeneSetEnrichmentAnalysis.md)
  : Perform gene set enrichment analysis with GSVA.
- [`extractMonocleTrajectory()`](https://mihem.github.io/CerebroNexus/reference/extractMonocleTrajectory.md)
  : Extract trajectory from Monocle and add to Seurat object.

  : Get marker genes for specified grouping variables in Seurat object.
